purpose: R2C5A0 — the operational attempt receipt's type/contract half. PL rows pin the structural classification law (reserved-without-sent is NoneInitiated and replayable; sent-without-settled is Ambiguous and never automatically replayed; settled is not reconciled at all), the first-write-wins marker discipline, and the agreement between this crate's replay convenience and the landed ExternalEffectState rule. PL06 pins that a conflicting marker preserves the held instant. Review R1 findings H1-H3 hardened this manifest's runner rather than its rows. PL07-PL08 pin the injected byte bounds on the two identity fields, which are the receipt's only variable-length content.
isolation: Every mutation is applied in its own disposable worktree at the exact committed candidate. The calling worktree remains unchanged.
scope_note: A0 is types and contract only. The store table, the fenced write path, the startup reconciler and every crash cut belong to A1/B/I and receive NO rows here — a row for an absent producer would witness an invention. The unrepresentability of a request-sent-without-reservation receipt is compile-fail-carried by probe 51 and is deliberately not re-earned by a runnable row.
prefix_note: This manifest owns ONE whole prefix, PL, allocated by the mutation prefix policy after a read-only inventory across the accepted canonical and every admitted active candidate root found it globally unused. Whole-prefix comparison keeps PL distinct from the landed P rows in the store manifest.

mutations.law: A reserved attempt that never sent bytes is NoneInitiated, and therefore replayable
An attempt whose request was sent and never settled is Ambiguous, and is never automatically replayed
A settled receipt is not reconciled at all, so no reconciler can write a second terminal for it
An exact retry of the same marker instant is idempotent, and a DIFFERENT second marker is a typed conflict that never silently replaces the held one
The receipt's replay convenience agrees with the landed ExternalEffectState rule and cannot become a softer second rule
A conflicting second marker preserves the held instant rather than overwriting it
An attempt identity longer than the injected maximum cannot form a receipt, and the bound is measured in UTF-8 bytes
The session identity bound is enforced too, and its refusal is a distinct kind
